name: options-desk
description: Claude Code skills for options engineering: Black-Scholes-Merton and Black-76 pricing, Greeks with explicit units, a robust implied-volatility solver, exact multi-leg payoffs and breakevens, OCC/OSI symbols and chain data hygiene, multi-leg orders on Interactive Brokers, Alpaca, Tradier and Zerodha Kite, NSE/SEBI F&O rules (Tuesday expiries, lot sizes, expiry-day margin, STT 2026) and options backtesting without fantasy fills.
